test_BotConfigTest_has_valid_substrate: test that each bot config has a valid substrate from the available substrates
test_BotConfigTest_model_exists: test that each bot's model path exists as a directory on disk
test_BotConfigTest_substrate_matches_mod: test that each bot's substrate matches the substrate inferred from its model path
test_BotConfigTest_no_duplicates: test that no two bot configs share the same configuration object
test_BotConfigTest_models_used_by_bots: test that all available models are referenced by at least one bot config
